title: Proxies
subtitle: Make websites see your browser in another place, through a proxy you rent.
empty.title: Browse from another place
empty.text: Add a proxy you rent, then pick it when you start a session: websites see the browser where the proxy is.
empty.checked: It is checked before use, and the session takes its place’s time zone and languages.
empty.around: Nothing leaves around it: name lookups go through it too.
check.busy: Busy, try again in a moment
check.protocol: Not a proxy at that address
check.unexpected: The proxy answered, but not as expected
delete.confirm: Delete “{name}”? Sessions can no longer browse from it.

delete.inUse.one: “{name}” is in use by 1 session. Close it first.
delete.inUse.other: “{name}” is in use by {count} sessions. Close them first.

add.title: Add proxy
add.subtitle: Checked as it connects: websites see its browsers where it is.
edit.title: Edit “{name}”
edit.subtitle: A new address is checked before it replaces the old one.
name: Name
address.help: From your proxy provider. Supports http, https and socks5.
address.now: Now {address}. Leave empty to keep it; a new address replaces its user name and password too.
address.now.user: Now {address}, with a user name. Leave empty to keep it; a new address replaces its user name and password too.
address.now.password: Now {address}, with a user name and password. Leave empty to keep it; a new address replaces its user name and password too.
timezone.help: The browser’s clock, as websites see it.
languages.help: The ones websites are asked for, first preferred.
save.busy: Busy, try again in a moment.
